notes.title: GRIMWAR Update Ver. 1.04
notes.content:
[h1]Hands and Doors Update[/h1]
Hello everyone, Caden at it again - I come bearing some news of a new update and some patch-notes for all of you!

This time around the list is shorter, but fear not! I have information and goodies aplenty of what we've been working on at Bookwyrm just at the end of this message. But first! 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] All doors now boast VFX that shows through walls at the end of an arena, be lost no longer!
[*] The Thaumaturge's hand-sprites have all been updated to match the introduction cutscene and artwork (they now have bandages on them)
[*] There have been changes to the level progression in the final stage's south-most pathway. It looks a bit more 'in place' and put together.
[*] Certain kill floors have been adjusted, as players were getting respawned when they shouldn't have been
[*] numerous bug-fixes
[/list]

And now for a sneak peek for what we've been working on at Bookwyrm
[url=https://ibb.co/sBjqfP6][img]https://i.ibb.co/rWkHjtc/Urchin-Final-Concept.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://ibb.co/PsXn0kBk][img]https://i.ibb.co/xK90dZVZ/Urchin3-DFinal.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://ibb.co/93smsb2M][img]https://i.ibb.co/x8JKJ1G4/Cathedral-Concept.png[/img][/url]

There's a few more things to be seen, had, and done - but that should be able to wait for a later time. Keep your ear out, we've got more changes on the way. 

See all of you next time!

notes.title: GRIMWAR Update Ver. 1.03
notes.content:
[h1]Controllers and Clarity Update[/h1]
Hey again, Caden here - I come bearing wonderful news and patch-notes for you all.

Momentous days here at Bookwyrm - thank you all for 
[h2]3000 [/h2]
all-time unique players! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7L8678Kq/gwimwaw.png[/img]

This time around we have a decently sized update coming to you that fixes a few things, makes speedrunning easier, make the archmage's tower easier to navigate, and enemies easier to find.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller mapping layouts have been changed - no longer are they 'bumper jumper' controls, but instead have been changed to a more standard scheme due to high demand. Possibility of bringing it back as an option later is possible!
[*] All levels have had tweaks to lighting to make them easier to navigate, hopefully meaning Thaumaturges don't get [i]as[/i] lost during their descent.
[*] The remaining 3 enemies in a wave are revealed through walls to players via an outline, enemies be lost in the level no longer!
[*] Certain entities in the final fight are no longer accidentally skippable, and have been added to the wave counter in those areas.
[*] Kill-floors are now one-way - Lab Speedrunners Rejoice! (This was implemented last patch, this is more of a hotfix to certain kill-floors not working.)
[*] Level-End screens have been updated, now continuing, quitting, and restarting are easier. 
[*] A 'Quick Restart' button has been added to the menu, this will later be [i]additionally[/i] mapped to a key on the keyboard for quick-er resets
[*] Updates have been made to the Ghost feature, and it more reliably updates based on time.
[*] Player falling is now capped... again, players were phasing through triggers in the tower!
[*] There were certain 'friendly' gargoyles that refused to fire at the Thaumaturge, they have since been re-agressed.
[*] 'lips' between areas have been minimized - hopefully Thaumaturges will no longer bounce back from whence-they-came at light speed.
[*] numerous bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Coming Next (Soon...ish)[/h2]
We have a lot of very exciting things that are on their way, and we're working diligently to send out some new updates as new bugs, and desired features based on player feedback arise. 

Our sights are set currently on:
1. Bug-squashing
2. Feature and conveyance enrichment
3. Development on a fun, slow-moving new entity that seems to have evaded the Thaumaturge up until now. They love cuddling (if you can get past the spines)
4. Development on a new post-game area has our heads in the clouds, and we're beyond excited to start sharing some things with you. 

Thanks again for 3000 unique players!

notes.title: GRIMWAR Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[h1]SALUTATIONS THAUMATURGES[/h1]
Heya, Caden here - Thank you all so much for playing GRIMWAR, here we have the first round of hotfixes coming your way, fixing some common issues that players have been running into throughout playtime. There's not too many of these, but we're working on some REALLY BIG bugfixes and changes that you can expect to see very shortly

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Infinite Aero bug after combining a spell has been fixed (Sorry speedrunners, this just isn't intentional)
[*] Updates to the general level end screen
[*] Updates to ghost mode, should now save your best time consistently
[*] Updates to player falling, no longer should you clip through triggers ;)
[*] Testing out a one way kill floor(s) in certain areas, give them a try!
[*] Quick restart buttons in the pause menu and at the end of levels (not yet set up for controller)
[/list]

Furthermore, let it be known that we're working on a content patch for the game, we'll have more information for you shortly. Enjoy!
